loci.name: k-and-finite-width-artifact-vs-class-property
loci.one_line: Is the ensemble's underperformance a K/finite-width/capacity artifact (favouring candidate D, taxonomy) or an intrinsic surrogate-class property (favouring candidate C, mechanism)? Reconcile our K-flip with Li/Rudner/Wilson's K-robustness and with NTK/spectral-bias theory.
loci.opposing_positions: Us: ranking flips with K (K=2 ensemble 0.95 > GP 0.846; K=5 weakest) -> the gap is a tuning/capacity confound, ranking-flip is NONE FOUND. L/R/W: K=5-vs-10 ablation shows 'the different ensembles perform similarly... robustness of our results to this hyperparameter'; plus a third, unchased L/R/W mechanism ('small BO datasets prevent ensemble mode-diversity'). NTK/spectral: infinite-width nets ARE GPs, finite nets spectrally biased toward smooth -> jaggedness is a width artifact (undercuts C). Question: does the NTK/spectral REGIME (width thresholds, training) actually match this paper's ensemble architecture, or is it a suggestive analogy?
loci.rationale: The single fork that decides C-vs-D and N2 novelty. If K/width is the driver, D (taxonomy) is the strongest paper and C's mechanism story is undercut by our own K-sweep.

loci.name: n4-sigma-mechanism-scope-and-ovadia
loci.one_line: How much of the distance-aware / implicit-trust-region mechanism (N4) is owned by SNGP/DUQ, and does DUE's 'a GP is not automatically variance-growing' caveat even apply to our EXACT GP + SVGP (standard kernels, not deep-kernel)? Fetch+grep Ovadia 2019.
loci.opposing_positions: SNGP OWNS the raw distance-aware mechanism (variance grows away from data; ensembles confidently wrong far from data). But: (a) DUE's caveat that a GP doesn't automatically get variance growth is about DEEP-KERNEL GPs with learned features -- may NOT apply to our exact-GP+SVGP with standard kernels, so the corpus may be OVER-citing DUE against the sigma-mechanism; (b) our own beta=0 control (0.51->0.47) argues sigma is not the mediator; (c) TuRBO uses Thompson not LCB. Ovadia 2019 (cited by DUE/DUQ/TuRBO, never fetched) is the foundational 'ensembles-under-shift' source -- fetch+grep it to pin what is owned.
loci.rationale: Determines the N4 verdict and whether C's mechanism survives on the sigma side. The DUE scope catch could change a FOUND to a NONE-FOUND. Requires fetching Ovadia 2019.

loci.name: audit-strengthens-and-n9-integrity
loci.one_line: Is 'a de-confounding audit that STRENGTHENS the effect' genuinely unclaimed within ML/CS (N9, D's differentiator)? Resolve the one N9 source flagged as checked-by-summary-only (anti-fabrication violation) by fetch+grep or mark NOT VERIFIABLE.
loci.opposing_positions: Reality-check genre norm: audit SHRINKS the effect (Melis, Musgrave, Lucic, Ferrari). Us + partials: audit GROWS it (eta^2 0.37->0.405; Recht relative-slope; Bressan psychology). INTEGRITY: the miss-catcher log admits one N9 candidate (Robinson/Glen/Lee, QSAR genre) was 'checked via search summary' only, NOT fetched -- must be fetched+grepped or explicitly moved to NOT VERIFIABLE, since N9 is candidate D's rhetorical differentiator and this project has caught 4 fabricated citations.
loci.rationale: N9 is what separates D from 'yet another ablation'. The verdict is currently 'mixed' and rests partly on an unverified citation -- resolving it is high-leverage and an integrity requirement.

loci.name: n7-roughening-beyond-offline-mbo
loci.one_line: Has ANYONE (in BO / kernel methods / any field, not just offline MBO) roughened a smooth model to prove smoothness is the CAUSAL axis of a performance gap? Decides whether candidate C's bidirectional-manipulation claim is 'first at all' or merely 'first in offline MBO'.
loci.opposing_positions: Within offline MBO: IGNITE/MS-DDEO/ROOT/Boosting-sensitivity all smooth or select-by-smoothness in ONE direction (NONE FOUND for bidirectional). Untested: BO/GP kernel-lengthscale ablations, Matern-nu sweeps, RKHS-smoothness studies OUTSIDE offline MBO that vary smoothness in both directions to establish causality. This is a NEW search within the depth budget, flagged verbatim in redundancy-audit.md and by both loci analysts.
loci.rationale: C's sharpest remaining exposure: a kernel-lengthscale or Matern-nu ablation elsewhere could partially pre-empt the 'smoothness is causal' claim. Requires a targeted new search + fetch.

loci.name: optimizer-reversal-unearned-and-candidate-a-credit
loci.one_line: Is the 'field innovates on the axis that doesn't matter' reversal (eta^2_opt=0.01 vs PGS's premise that search strategy is the neglected axis) a defensible literature claim, and does L/R/W's 'optimizer as fixed nuisance' mean candidate A is UNDER-credited for the not-an-optimizer-effect half?
loci.opposing_positions: PGS (Chemingui AAAI24) premise: 'offline BBO has focused on improving surrogate models while using fixed search strategies' -- the search strategy is the neglected axis. Our eta^2_opt=0.01 contradicts it (the named belief, refuted). BUT our own FLAW_LEDGER says 0.01 is confounded (unequal oracle budgets, trust-region closes gradient collapse) -> reversal 'currently unearned'. Separately, L/R/W held optimizer as a FIXED NUISANCE VARIABLE, so it cannot own A's 'not-an-optimizer-effect' half -> A may be under-credited relative to the orchestrator's harsh self-rating.
loci.rationale: Bears directly on the A/C/D recommendation and on the paper's strongest rhetorical hook (named belief refuted). Literature side (PGS premise, L/R/W design) is verifiable now.

loci.name: n3-classic-bo-beta-calibration
loci.one_line: Does the classic BO acquisition-calibration literature (GP-UCB beta_t schedules, Srinivas et al. 2010; kappa tuning) already own N3's 'a shared beta delivers different effective conservatism across surrogates with different sigma scales'?
loci.opposing_positions: N3 is the thinnest-covered claim (2-3 sources). Ghasemipour is the closest analog but different mechanism (target independence, not cross-class sigma scale). The foundational GP-UCB beta_t literature (Srinivas 2010) and BO practice of tuning kappa/beta per surrogate were NEVER checked by the miss-catcher -- they might own the 'nominal beta != effective conservatism' idea (though for a SINGLE surrogate, not ACROSS surrogate classes). Check + fetch Srinivas 2010 if it bears.
loci.rationale: N3's NONE FOUND is currently the least-stress-tested; the classic BO beta literature is the obvious place a reviewer would point. Cheap to check, closes the thinnest gap.
